capabilities.submit-input: each supplier for quotes, the client for the cap
capabilities.execute-operation: the executor, which holds no share and receives no view
capabilities.request-disclosure and receive-view: per view: the client for the client view, each supplier for its own view, anybody for the public view, the auditor for the state as it is
capabilities.approve-disclosure: the controller of the scope and the client

requires.by: an account other than the executor

release.recheck: every holder asks the ledger whether the release stands immediately before it contributes

inFlight: a request names a policy version and ends when that version is superseded
revocation: ends requests not yet released; what was released stays released
